title: Yummy Nutty Norwegian Walnut Lasagna
description: A rich vegetarian lasagna bursting with crunchy walnuts and gooey cheeses, perfect for midnight cravings.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and add minced garlic, sauté for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the fresh spinach to the skillet, stir until wilted, season with salt and pepper, then remove from heat.
In a mixing bowl combine the ricotta cheese, chopped walnuts, wilted spinach, and half the grated parmesan, stirring until well blended.
Lightly grease a baking dish and spread a thin layer of tomato sauce across the bottom.
Place a layer of no-boil lasagna sheets over the sauce, then spread a generous layer of the walnut ricotta mixture, sprinkle shredded mozzarella, and repeat to build three layers.
Finish with a top layer of lasagna sheets, cover with the remaining tomato sauce, mozzarella, and parmesan cheese.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes in the preheated oven.
Remove the foil and bake for an additional 10 minutes until the cheese is melted and the surface is golden.
Allow the lasagna to rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
